title: 接受檢查
checks: 只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. A continuous live-action extreme close-up of the same Taiwanese womans eye and surrounding skin in the ultrasound examination room. Preserve her exact eyelid shape, eyebrow, skin texture and hair. Her gaze makes a small natural shift toward the monitor, then she blinks once slowly and holds her gaze. The out-of-focus monitor remains in its existing position and the soft reflection changes naturally with the eye movement. Keep the camera steady; only the eye, eyelid and subtle facial muscles move. No tears pouring, new lettering, dramatic lighting changes or change of identity. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 6.583 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room ambience, restrained clothing rustle and physical sounds synchronized to the visible movements; rain and distant traffic are audible only in the office scenes.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
